steps:
https://factory-data.jomcgi.dev/health.json reports status unhealthy. Find the down component:

curl -s https://factory-data.jomcgi.dev/health.json

If the summary says that the component list is unknown, Prometheus cannot scrape health-exporter. The file still lists the down components. Also check the exporter pod.
kubectl -n prometheus get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=health-exporter

factory-cluster: the argocd Application is not Healthy, or it did not reconcile in 15 min.
kubectl -n argocd get application argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.health.status} {.status.reconciledAt}'

jomcgi-site-worker: the Cloudflare read failed, or the Worker's latest deployment has no ID. Check that the token Secret exists, then check the Worker's deployments in Cloudflare.
kubectl -n factory-public get secret factory-health-cloudflare

alert-test: the HOME-415 alert check is on. Remove valuesObject: {healthAlertTest: true} from spec.source.helm in projects/factory-public/deploy/application.yaml.

The health Job logs only the published document. It keeps no error text.

FactoryHealthUnhealthy and FactoryHealthStale replace the hub's Honeycomb trigger "jomcgi.dev /health composite unhealthy" (aJgkA4vC2m8) on https://jomcgi.dev/health. HOME-261 removes that trigger and the hub route.
